        [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][5 + c] if grid[r][5 + c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)],

    ]
    priority = {5: 1, 8: 2, 4: 3, 9: 4}
